title: Urban Safety Perception Through the Lens of Large Multimodal Models: A Persona-based Approach
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) for urban safety perception and explicitly investigates socio-demographic biases (age, gender, and nationality). While it includes a section on the ethical implications of these biases for urban planning, it does not evaluate religion, faith, or ethical systems as a core component of its benchmarking or methodology.
